verses.commentary: Hear this, you priests! Pay attention, Israelites! Listen, royal house! All three power centers addressed. You have been a snare at Mizpah, a net on Tabor. Sacred sites become traps. Leaders who should guide instead ensnare.
The rebels are knee-deep in slaughter. Violence saturates. I will discipline all of them. No exceptions.
I know all about Ephraim. Nothing hidden. Israel is not hidden from me. God's knowledge is complete. Ephraim has turned to prostitution. The diagnosis is certain.
Their deeds do not permit them to return. Sin has created its own bondage. A spirit of prostitution is in their heart. Internal corruption. They do not acknowledge the Lord. The relationship is dead.

Israel's arrogance testifies against them. Pride as witness for the prosecution. Both Israel and Ephraim stumble. Even Judah stumbles with them. The southern kingdom caught in the northern corruption.
They go with flocks and herds to seek the Lord. Bringing sacrifices. But they will not find him. He has withdrawn. Religious activity without relationship is useless.
They are unfaithful to the Lord. Illegitimate children born. When they celebrate New Moon feasts, judgment will devour their fields. Their religious calendar marks their destruction.
Sound the trumpet in Gibeah, the horn in Ramah. Alarm signals across Benjamin. Battle cry in Beth-aven. Lead on, Benjamin. War is coming.
Ephraim will be laid waste on the day of reckoning. Certain doom. Among the tribes of Israel I proclaim what is certain. No ambiguity.
Judah's leaders are like those who move boundary stones. Land theft. Violating property rights established by God. Wrath poured out like water. Overwhelming judgment.
Ephraim is oppressed, trampled in judgment. Suffering begins. Intent on pursuing idols. Even under pressure, the choice remains.
I am like a moth to Ephraim, like rot to Judah. Slow decay. God as the hidden destroyer. Gradual ruin from within.

When Ephraim saw his sickness, he went to Assyria. The wrong physician. He sent to the great king. Political alliance instead of repentance. But he is not able to cure you. Assyria cannot heal spiritual disease.
I will be like a lion to Ephraim. From moth to lion. Slow decay becomes violent attack. I will tear them to pieces and go away. God as predator. No rescue.
I will return to my lair until they acknowledge their guilt. God withdraws to wait. In their misery they will earnestly seek me. Suffering produces seeking. Pain opens the door to return.
